verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, including a state Secretary of State site. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions or probes a robots.txt at sos.wa.gov. The only probe checks the DOR tax portal's JavaScript shell, which says nothing about crawl directives.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
